description: Alumbrado Público, Bogotá D.C. is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Unidad Administrativa Especial de Servicios Públicos - UAESP. Servicio público no domiciliario de iluminación, inherente al servicio de energía eléctrica, que se presta con el fin de dar visibilidad· al espacio público, bienes de uso público y demás espacios de libre circulación, con tránsito vehicular o peatonal, dentro del perímetro urbano y rural de un municipio o distrito, para el normal desarrollo de ... Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Unidad Administrativa Especial de Servicios Públicos - UAESP. Its tags are Alumbrado Público, Luminarias, Luminarias Tecnologia Halogenuros Metalicos, Luminarias Tecnologia LED, Luminarias Tecnologia SODIO. It offers 8 resource(s) in DXF, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, GPKG, KML. The portal shows 2022-05-19 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike 4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
